label_hierarchy.policy: Deterministic mapping from label_raw to label_category and is_attack using authoritative taxonomy.

protocol_consistency.policy: Reconciled protocol_name string to IANA standard matching canonical Protocol Type integer.

dispersion_invariant.policy: Enforced Std = sqrt(max(Variance, 0)) treating Variance as authoritative (higher generative fidelity KS 0.1665 vs 0.3241).

min_avg_max_ordering.policy: Refused arbitrary clipping or row-wise sorting because sorting degrades Min KS statistic from 0.4973 to 0.7837 (+57% error) and distorts order-statistic distribution.

aggregation_ratio.policy: Refused overwriting Tot sum or AVG because artificial recomputation degrades Tot sum KS from 0.5151 to 0.6107 and inflates AVG mean from 197.45 to 462.82.

discrete_and_binary.policy: Verified discrete counts are 100% integer compliant. Verified protocol indicators in CICIoT2023 represent flow-window packet proportion ratios in [0.0, 1.0], not pure {0, 1} integers; binarization rejected as destructive.
